Careers at Jayveecons

Build Things
That Last

Jayveecons has been engineering and building industrial equipment since 1987. We are a company where engineers actually make things — from first drawing to last weld. If that appeals to you, we want to hear from you.

Why Jayveecons

A Place Where
Engineers Do Real Work

Jayveecons is an engineering and manufacturing company in the original sense. We design equipment, fabricate it in-house, install it on-site, and support it for its working life. For an engineer, that means end-to-end ownership — you see your work through from calculation to commissioning, not handed off after a drawing review.

Our 90,000 sq.ft facility in Bengaluru houses mechanical engineering, structural and plate fabrication, CNC machining, and assembly. The team is small enough that every person's contribution is visible, and experienced enough that there is something to learn from almost everyone around you.

We are not a large corporation with rigid hierarchies. Decisions get made by people who understand the work. Good ideas from junior engineers reach senior engineers. Problems on-site get escalated and solved, not passed along a chain until they become someone else's issue.

Design to Commissioning
Engineers work across the full project lifecycle — process calculations, fabrication drawings, site installation, and performance testing. No artificial handoffs.
Cross-Sector Exposure
You will work on cement, mining, food processing, and waste management projects. Each sector brings different material and engineering challenges.
Nearly Four Decades of Knowledge
Working alongside engineers and fabricators with decades of domain experience in VSK, conveying systems, and bulk material processing is an education you cannot get from a textbook.
Team That Builds Together
Engineering, fabrication, and sales sit under one roof. You work with the people who will actually make and install what you design — and they will tell you when a drawing does not work in practice.
Roles We Hire For

Where You Might Fit

We do not always have open positions advertised, but we are continuously interested in strong candidates in these areas. If your background matches, send us your CV regardless of whether a specific role is listed.

Engineering
Mechanical Design Engineer
Equipment design for material handling and processing systems. Process calculations, mechanical sizing, GA and detail drawing production, BOM preparation. Works from client brief through to fabrication-ready documentation.
AutoCAD / SolidWorks Conveyor design Mechanical calcs B.E. Mechanical
Engineering
Process Engineer
Process flow design, material balance calculations, equipment sizing and selection for bulk handling systems. Interfaces between client process requirements and mechanical design team. VSK or bulk processing experience is valued.
Process design Bulk material handling Cement / Mining B.E. / M.E. Chemical or Mechanical
Projects
Erection & Commissioning Engineer
On-site installation, alignment, and commissioning of VECTOMEC™ equipment at customer plants. Manages civil interface, mechanical assembly, drive commissioning, no-load trials, and process handover. Requires willingness to travel.
Site experience Conveyor / elevator installation Drive systems Diploma / B.E. Mechanical
Fabrication
Workshop Fabricator / Welder
Structural and plate fabrication of conveyors, elevators, hoppers, silos, and processing equipment. Reading and working to engineering drawings. Certified welding in MIG, TIG, or arc processes. Experience with SS and AR steel welcomed.
Structural fabrication Certified welding Drawing reading ITI / Diploma
Sales & Business Development
Technical Sales Engineer
Customer engagement for VECTOMEC™ equipment and services — responding to enquiries, preparing technical proposals, and developing new client relationships across cement, mining, and food processing sectors. Must be comfortable discussing engineering requirements with plant engineers and procurement teams.
Technical proposal writing Bulk material handling Client relationship B.E. Mechanical preferred
Operations
Production Planning & QC
Workshop production planning, job card management, material procurement coordination, and quality inspection — ensuring fabrication output meets engineering specifications and delivery commitments. Experience with small-to-medium batch engineering manufacturing preferred.
Production planning Quality inspection Engineering manufacturing Diploma / B.E.
How to Apply

Send Us
Your CV

We keep applications straightforward. Send your CV and a brief note on what you are looking for to our HR team. If your background matches a current or upcoming requirement, we will respond within a week.

You do not need to wait for a specific role to be advertised. We prefer to meet strong candidates before we have an urgent vacancy — it gives both sides more time to assess the fit properly.

Applications are reviewed by Mrs. Sreenandini Jayaram, our HR Manager, who works closely with our engineering and operations leadership on all hiring decisions.

01
Send your CV
Email to hr@jayveecons.com with a short covering note on your experience and what kind of role you are looking for.
02
Initial conversation
If there is a potential fit, our HR team will reach out to schedule an initial call or meeting within one to two weeks.
03
Technical interview
Suitable candidates meet with the relevant engineering or operations lead for a technical discussion relevant to the role.
04
Offer
Successful candidates receive a formal offer. We aim to keep the process clear and move quickly once we have identified the right person.
